items.title: Jake Ferguson: Working with trainers Wednesday
items.description:
Head coach Brian Schottenheimer said Ferguson (ankle) will work with the Cowboys' training staff during Wednesday's practice, Briana Aldridge of CBS News Texas reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Not practicing Wednesday
items.description:
Skattebo (hamstring) didn't take part in Wednesday's practice and instead was seen working with a trainer on the side, Jordan Raanan of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Emeka Egbuka: Doesn't practice Wednesday
items.description:
Head coach Todd Bowles said Egbuka (foot) didn't practice Wednesday, but the wide receiver was able to run on a side field, and the Buccaneers will see how he feels Thursday, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
